# Tend

> The easiest way for churches to collect prayer requests: one QR code, one inbox.

Tend is a QR-code prayer-request collection app for churches. A church signs up,
prints a QR code, and places it in the sanctuary. Congregants scan it with their
phone camera and share prayer requests, check-ins, praises, or questions through
a simple form. Every submission lands in the church's private prayer inbox with
status tracking (new, praying, prayed for, archived).

## Key facts

- Website: https://tendpray.com/
- Built for churches; anyone on the church team can set it up, not only the pastor.
- Congregants need nothing installed: the phone camera opens a web form.
- Prayer requests are private to the church's signed-in team. Nothing is posted publicly.
- Free plan: free forever, no card required. One QR code and prayer page.
- Paid plans (Starter $29/mo, Growth $49/mo, Large Church $99/mo; annual billing
  available): 30-day free trial, no card required to start. Manage or cancel anytime.
- Contact: support@tendpray.com
- Privacy: https://tendpray.com/#/privacy
- Pricing: https://tendpray.com/#/pricing

## How a church starts

1. Sign up at https://tendpray.com/#/signup
2. Tend generates a QR code and prayer page for the church
3. Print the QR poster and place it in the sanctuary
4. Requests arrive in the church dashboard inbox
